title: BPW-2026-0555
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0555
CD ALL
REVISED TASK ORDER SOLICITATION (TOS) NO. 34 – PSOMAS
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue a revision of the task for TOS No. 34 to Psomas, increasing the budget authority from $880,000 to $1,080,000 for inventory and assessment of the City of Los Angeles’s public right-of-way pedestrian facilities Phase I: Pilot services for the Bureau of Engineering Sidewalk Compliance Division.
(W.O.: E1909337, C-134269)
summary: Raises Psomas' Bureau of Engineering task order for inventorying and assessing public right-of-way pedestrian facilities from $880,000 to $1,080,000, covering the Phase I pilot for the Sidewalk Compliance Division.

details.action: revised task order and budget increase

outcome.text: REPORT ADOPTED, SUBJECT TO CONDITIONS, FORTHWITH
